## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [曇無竭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%87%E7%84%A1%E7%AB%AD) Tánwújié is a Mahāyāna sūtra recounting the future Buddhahood of *Guānshìyīn* 觀世音 (Avalokiteśvara) — i.e. the Buddha's prediction (*shòujì* / *vyākaraṇa*) that this most-venerated of bodhisattvas will eventually attain Buddhahood as *Pǔguāng gōngdé Shānwáng Tathāgata* 普光功德山王如來. The work is one of the principal scriptural foundations of the Avalokiteśvara cult in East Asian Buddhism.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (420 – 479) reflects the Liú-Sòng period of Tánwújié's activity.

The Taishō text (T0371) is established on the standard apparatus.
